artworks.title: Little Finger, Dakota Sioux
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their left hand on their hip and their right hand on a shield or drum. The person has long, straight hair and distinct facial features. They wear traditional clothing, including a shirt with long sleeves and decorative elements like fur and beadwork. The attire includes a breastplate and various accessories around the waist. The person stands on grass with a large tepee or tent in the background, decorated with faint designs and patterns.

artworks.title: Two Sisters
artworks.description: The image shows two women captured in a vertical composition where both are visible from the waist up. They are positioned facing each other in a close manner. The woman on the left is seen in profile with hair styled in soft curls framing her face. The woman on the right is looking slightly down with her head turned towards the other, her hair also curly with a noticeable flower adorning it. Both women wear elegant and elaborate dresses with puffed sleeves and lace detailing. The woman on the right holds a small bouquet of dark flowers in her right hand. They appear to be in an indoor setting, in front of a window with a lattice pattern, casting a soft light into the room. The background is softly out of focus, emphasizing the scene between the two figures.

artworks.title: Joaquin Sorolla y Bastida
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph shows a man standing, his body turned to the left, with arms crossed in front of him. He looks out at us. He has pale skin, a full gray beard, short gray hair, deep-set eyes, and a neutral expression. He is wearing a large double-breasted coat that obscures his entire body. The background is plain gray, with some areas of lighter gray.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his hands in the pockets of his suit jacket, facing forward with a relaxed posture. The man appears to have a serene expression, with dark, neatly styled hair. He is wearing a dark suit, white dress shirt, and tie, typical of early 20th-century fashion. The background is a plain wall with visible stains and marks, and the edges of the image are worn and stained, giving it an antique look.

artworks.title: The Dancing Lesson
artworks.description: The image shows four girls dancing inside a room. They are positioned in a circle, holding the skirts of their dresses as they move. The girls have curly hair with bows, and are dressed in elaborate dresses. One of the girls holds a fan. The room has dark curtains, a lattice-designed window, decorative plants, and wooden flooring.

artworks.title: Rodin
artworks.description: The image shows a man's side profile with short dark hair and a beard, situated facing to the right. He is wearing a dark garment. The background is blurred with a sepia-toned indoor setting. No specific details of jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: The Bat
artworks.description: This dark photograph shows a person standing near the top left corner with their arms extended out to either side, appearing to grasp a piece of dark fabric or a cloak. The individual's head is obscured in shadow, and their pale, nude body is only partially visible. Behind them, on the right, appears to be a large rock. Closer to us, at the bottom of the photograph, the ground appears rough and natural, littered with twigs, long branches, and stones. The scene is very dark, and some details are hard to make out.

artworks.title: Family Group (Mrs. White, Maynard & Lewis)
artworks.description: Three individuals are shown in the image. Two boys on the left, wearing jackets over light shirts. The boy on the left has short, neatly combed hair and a serious expression. The other boy has slightly longer hair and a serious expression with wide eyes. A woman on the right, slightly behind the boys, has a middle-parted hair falling smoothly back and is looking towards the boys. The background features a richly patterned fabric with florals and architectural motifs along the bottom edge.

artworks.title: "Philemon"
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile silhouette of a seated person facing right towards sheet music on a music stand. Only the upper body is visible, with the head slightly angled downward. The individual's facial features and hair are not distinct due to being backlit. The person appears to be wearing a jacket, but details are unclear. A large, illuminated circular lamp is in the background, along with a faint picture or painting on the wall. The scene has a soft, muted quality.

artworks.title: Mabel Cramer
artworks.artist: Clarence H. White, and Alfred Stieglitz
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a portrait style with a neutral facial expression. They have long dark hair, wearing a dark garment with their hand near their shoulder. The background is a soft-focus gradient.

artworks.title: The Window Seat
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated sideways. She is leaning slightly back with her left arm on her lap and her right hand holding a piece of paper. Her facial features are captured in profile, with calm expression. She has slightly wavy hair tied back in a loose bun. She wears a long dress with puffy sleeves and a floral pattern, cascading down to the floor. In the background, there is a wall with a framed picture and a window to her right, suggesting a vintage setting.

artworks.title: George Borup
artworks.description: The image displays a man's upper body, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is positioned to the left, looking directly at the camera. His facial features are partially in shadow. He has cheekbones, a jawline, and deep-set eyes, giving his expression a contemplative look. His dark, short hair is partly covered by a thick fur hood. He wears a heavy fur coat, emphasizing its texture. The background is dark and blurry, highlighting the man and his hood. No accessories or objects are visible.

artworks.title: The Footbridge
artworks.description: Three women in a natural, outdoor setting. Two standing, one sitting. The seated woman with head resting on hand, looking to the side. She wears a white dress and dark shawl. The standing women seen in three-quarter view; one walking, one standing and holding hands. Background shows trees and garden with soft sunlight.

artworks.title: Letitia Felix
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated person with their hands clasped together in front of them. The individual is facing forward, with their body slightly turned to the side. They have a relaxed posture, with loosely arranged hair that falls around their face, showing facial features like a rounded face, large eyes, and a slightly open mouth. The person is wearing a velvet dress with long sleeves of a lighter fabric visible. The outer garment has a darker shoulder area. There is no visible jewelry or objects held. The background is plain and softly out of focus.

artworks.title: Miss Grace
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph shows a young girl sitting on a dark wooden-framed sofa with an opened book on her lap, her head tilted downward to look at it. She has pale skin and her facial features are slightly blurred. She is wearing a light-colored dress with long sleeves, dark stockings, and black shoes. Her long hair is flowing down her shoulders. The room has a patterned carpet and a framed picture on the otherwise blank wall behind her.

artworks.title: Gertrude Käsebier in Maine
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a large rock outdoors. She is captured from the waist up, positioned in a three-quarters view. The woman has a mature appearance with soft facial features and short, dark hair mostly hidden under a wide-brimmed hat. She is wearing a dark cape over a light-colored blouse and holding a cluster of flowers around her midsection. The background includes a calm body of water with a distant shoreline populated with trees and sparse buildings.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in an upper-body portrait, facing slightly to the side. They have distinct facial features, including a strong jawline, prominent cheekbones, and dark eyes looking directly at the camera. The person's dark hair is styled with longer strands falling over the forehead. They wear a dark garment resembling a robe over a white shirt with a high collar and a large dark bow tie. The background is blurred, with soft lighting emphasizing the subject's face. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects in the composition.

artworks.title: Letitia Felix and Her Sister in a Garden
artworks.description: The image shows two women outdoors. One woman is standing and the other is crouching. The standing woman is visible from head to toe, positioned slightly to the left as she faces the camera with her hands clasped in front of her. Her facial features are visible, framed by dark hair pulled back. She wears a long, light-colored dress with long sleeves. The crouching woman is seen from the back, wearing a similar dress, and appears to be examining a flower. Both women are in a garden surrounded by foliage, with a flower bed in the foreground. In the background, there is a building with large windows and potted ferns, suggesting they are in a garden next to a house. The image is tinted blue, resembling an old or stylized photograph.

artworks.title: Letitia Felix
artworks.description: The image displays a woman sitting on the edge of a table, facing the camera. She has fair hair pulled back, is wearing a light-colored dress with long sleeves, and is next to a small potted plant. The background features a patterned wall, a window to the left, and a decorative panel with faint bird or plant motifs. The image is in a monochrome blue tint.

artworks.title: Bedroom display in the Paris Universal Exposition of 1855
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Epsom Heath
artworks.medium: brown, gray, and green watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a high perspective, showing soft rolling hills stretching into the distance. The horizon is visible above the center, with gentle ridges and undulating terrain. More hills can be seen on the horizon. Delicate brushstrokes create a smooth transition between land and sky. The color palette is muted, with earthy and sepia tones. Some vegetation and small structures are visible among the hills. The sky is expansive, painted with broad strokes in a monochromatic theme.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to her left. Her facial features are delicate and she has a serious expression. She has dark hair styled in a smooth, tight updo with a middle part. She is wearing a formal plaid-patterned dress with a high white collar and voluminous sleeves gathered at the cuffs. The dress has decorative details and lace. One hand rests on her lap, and the other may be adjusting a part of her dress. She wears a ring on one of her fingers. The background is a plain, slightly textured, sepia-toned wall.

artworks.title: Saint John's Hospital, Canterbury
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of Andrew Wyld
artworks.description: The image shows a street view of a narrow lane lined with cottages. The horizon is positioned at the top third of the image with rooftops meeting the sky. Buildings and trees populate the area. The houses have steeply angled roofs and brick chimneys. At the end of the lane is a house with distinctive half-timbered construction. The sky has soft, diffuse clouds painted with light brushstrokes, creating a serene atmosphere. The color palette includes earthy tones, blues, grays, browns, and touches of greenery. A woman is near a washing line, adding to the everyday life scene. Figures are dispersed along the path, providing scale and perspective as they fade into the distance.
